# Commands

Every command `agent-figma` exposes, with the flags it takes and what it answers.

<!-- Generated by scripts/write-command-reference.mjs from the command catalog. Run `pnpm docs:write` after changing it. -->

The catalog is the source of truth, and the CLI reads it back to you:

```bash
agent-figma describe --json
agent-figma COMMAND --help
agent-figma COMMAND --help --json
```

## Flags every command takes

| Flag | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `--fields a,b.c` | Project the data down to the named paths. |
| `--format json\|ndjson\|table` | Choose the output representation. |
| `--help` | Print this page. Add --json for the same as metadata. |
| `--json` | Answer with the JSON envelope, whatever stdout is attached to. |
| `--no-color` | Leave terminal colour off. |
| `--pretty` | Indent JSON output. |
| `--profile NAME` | Named auth profile. Defaults to `default`. |
| `--raw` | Print response data without the success envelope. |
| `--version` | Print the version and exit. |

## Discovery

### `agent-figma describe`

Print the full command catalog as JSON.

```bash
agent-figma describe [--json]
```

| Flag | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `--json` | Answer with the JSON envelope, whatever stdout is attached to. |

```bash
agent-figma describe --json
```

Answers command metadata.

### `agent-figma completion bash|zsh`

Generate a shell completion script.

```bash
agent-figma completion bash|zsh
```

```bash
agent-figma completion zsh > ~/.zfunc/_agent-figma
```

Answers shell completion script.

## Authentication

### `agent-figma auth status`

Show the active Figma profile.

```bash
agent-figma auth status [--profile NAME] [--json]
```

| Flag | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `--profile NAME` | Named auth profile. Defaults to `default`. |
| `--json` | Answer with the JSON envelope, whatever stdout is attached to. |

```bash
agent-figma auth status --json
```

Answers sanitized profile status.

### `agent-figma auth login`

Connect a Figma profile with browser OAuth or a personal access token.

```bash
agent-figma auth login [--token TOKEN] [--profile NAME] [--scopes LIST] [--oauth] [--client-id ID] [--client-secret SECRET] [--redirect-uri URI] [--no-open] [--auth-url-out PATH] [--timeout-ms N] [--json]
```

| Flag | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `--token TOKEN` | Store this personal access token instead of starting OAuth. |
| `--profile NAME` | Named auth profile. Defaults to `default`. |
| `--scopes LIST` | Comma-separated read scopes to request. |
| `--oauth` | Use self-hosted OAuth with your own Figma app credentials. |
| `--client-id ID` | Figma app client id, for self-hosted OAuth. |
| `--client-secret SECRET` | Figma app client secret. Used for this process and never stored. |
| `--redirect-uri URI` | Redirect URI registered on the Figma app, for self-hosted OAuth. |
| `--no-open` | Print the authorization URL instead of opening a browser. |
| `--auth-url-out PATH` | Write the authorization URL to a file for a headless handoff. |
| `--timeout-ms N` | How long to wait for the browser callback. |
| `--json` | Answer with the JSON envelope, whatever stdout is attached to. |

```bash
agent-figma auth login
```

```bash
agent-figma auth login --token "$FIGMA_TOKEN" --json
```

Answers sanitized profile status.

### `agent-figma auth scopes`

```bash

```

| Flag | Meaning |
| --- | --- |


### `agent-figma auth profiles list`

List local Figma profiles.

```bash
agent-figma auth profiles list [--json]
```

| Flag | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `--json` | Answer with the JSON envelope, whatever stdout is attached to. |

```bash
agent-figma auth profiles list --json
```

Answers profile list.

### `agent-figma auth logout`

Delete a local Figma profile.

Deletes local state. It never changes anything in Figma.

```bash
agent-figma auth logout [--profile NAME] --yes [--json]
```

| Flag | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `--profile NAME` | Named auth profile. Defaults to `default`. |
| `--yes` | Confirm deleting the local profile. (required) |
| `--json` | Answer with the JSON envelope, whatever stdout is attached to. |

```bash
agent-figma auth logout --yes --json
```

Answers deleted profile status.

### `agent-figma auth test`

Test the active Figma profile.

Reads `GET /v1/me`.

Scopes: `current_user:read`.

```bash
agent-figma auth test [--profile NAME] [--json]
```

| Flag | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `--profile NAME` | Named auth profile. Defaults to `default`. |
| `--json` | Answer with the JSON envelope, whatever stdout is attached to. |

```bash
agent-figma auth test --json
```

Answers Figma user identity.

## Figma reads

### `agent-figma user get`

Show the current Figma user.

Reads `GET /v1/me`.

Scopes: `current_user:read`.

```bash
agent-figma user get [--profile NAME] [--json] [--fields a,b.c]
```

| Flag | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `--profile NAME` | Named auth profile. Defaults to `default`. |
| `--json` | Answer with the JSON envelope, whatever stdout is attached to. |
| `--fields a,b.c` | Project the data down to the named paths. |

```bash
agent-figma user get --json
```

Answers Figma user.

### `agent-figma team projects list TEAM_ID`

List projects in a Figma team.

Reads `GET /v1/teams/:team_id/projects`.

Scopes: `projects:read`.

```bash
agent-figma team projects list TEAM_ID [--profile NAME] [--json] [--format json|ndjson|table] [--fields a,b.c]
```

| Flag | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `--profile NAME` | Named auth profile. Defaults to `default`. |
| `--json` | Answer with the JSON envelope, whatever stdout is attached to. |
| `--format json\|ndjson\|table` | Choose the output representation. |
| `--fields a,b.c` | Project the data down to the named paths. |

```bash
agent-figma team projects list 123 --json
```

Answers project list.

### `agent-figma project files list PROJECT_ID`

List files in a Figma project.

Reads `GET /v1/projects/:project_id/files`.

Scopes: `files:read`.

```bash
agent-figma project files list PROJECT_ID [--profile NAME] [--json] [--format json|ndjson|table] [--fields a,b.c]
```

| Flag | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `--profile NAME` | Named auth profile. Defaults to `default`. |
| `--json` | Answer with the JSON envelope, whatever stdout is attached to. |
| `--format json\|ndjson\|table` | Choose the output representation. |
| `--fields a,b.c` | Project the data down to the named paths. |

```bash
agent-figma project files list 123 --json
```

Answers file list.

### `agent-figma file get FILE_OR_URL`

Read a Figma file, optionally bounded by depth.

Reads `GET /v1/files/:key`.

Scopes: `file_content:read`.

```bash
agent-figma file get FILE_OR_URL [--profile NAME] [--depth N] [--json] [--pretty] [--fields a,b.c]
```

| Flag | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `--profile NAME` | Named auth profile. Defaults to `default`. |
| `--depth N` | Bound how deep the document tree is read. |
| `--json` | Answer with the JSON envelope, whatever stdout is attached to. |
| `--pretty` | Indent JSON output. |
| `--fields a,b.c` | Project the data down to the named paths. |

```bash
agent-figma file get FIGMA_URL --depth 2 --json
```

Answers Figma file.

### `agent-figma file nodes get FILE_OR_URL`

Read multiple nodes from a Figma file.

Reads `GET /v1/files/:key/nodes`.

Scopes: `file_content:read`.

```bash
agent-figma file nodes get FILE_OR_URL --ids ID[,ID] [--profile NAME] [--json] [--fields a,b.c]
```

| Flag | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `--ids ID[,ID]` | Node ids, written 1:2 or the 1-2 form a Figma URL uses. (required) |
| `--profile NAME` | Named auth profile. Defaults to `default`. |
| `--json` | Answer with the JSON envelope, whatever stdout is attached to. |
| `--fields a,b.c` | Project the data down to the named paths. |

```bash
agent-figma file nodes get FIGMA_URL --ids 1:2,3:4 --json
```

Answers Figma nodes.

### `agent-figma node get FILE_OR_URL`

Reads `GET /v1/files/:key/nodes`.

Scopes: `file_content:read`.


| Flag | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `--id NODE_ID` | The node to read, when the URL does not carry one. |
| `--profile NAME` | Named auth profile. Defaults to `default`. |
| `--json` | Answer with the JSON envelope, whatever stdout is attached to. |
| `--pretty` | Indent JSON output. |
| `--fields a,b.c` | Project the data down to the named paths. |

```bash
agent-figma node get FIGMA_NODE_URL --json
```

Answers Figma node.

### `agent-figma image render FILE_OR_URL`

Render nodes from a Figma file.

Reads `GET /v1/images/:key`.

Scopes: `file_content:read`.

```bash
agent-figma image render FILE_OR_URL --ids ID[,ID] [--format json|ndjson|table] [--scale N] [--profile NAME] [--json] [--fields a,b.c]
```

| Flag | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `--ids ID[,ID]` | Node ids, written 1:2 or the 1-2 form a Figma URL uses. (required) |
| `--format json\|ndjson\|table` | Choose the output representation. |
| `--scale N` | Render scale, between 0.01 and 4. |
| `--profile NAME` | Named auth profile. Defaults to `default`. |
| `--json` | Answer with the JSON envelope, whatever stdout is attached to. |
| `--fields a,b.c` | Project the data down to the named paths. |

```bash
agent-figma image render FIGMA_URL --ids 1:2 --format png --json
```

Answers rendered image URLs.

## REST access

### `agent-figma api call OPERATION`

Call a bundled Figma GET operation with a JSON payload.

```bash
agent-figma api call OPERATION [--payload JSON] [--profile NAME] [--raw] [--format json|ndjson|table] [--fields a,b.c] [--json]
```

| Flag | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `--payload JSON` | JSON object of path and query values for the operation. |
| `--profile NAME` | Named auth profile. Defaults to `default`. |
| `--raw` | Print response data without the success envelope. |
| `--format json\|ndjson\|table` | Choose the output representation. |
| `--fields a,b.c` | Project the data down to the named paths. |
| `--json` | Answer with the JSON envelope, whatever stdout is attached to. |

```bash
agent-figma api call file.get --payload '{"key":"abc","depth":2}' --json
```

Answers Figma REST response.

### `agent-figma api endpoints list`

List bundled Figma REST endpoint metadata.

```bash
agent-figma api endpoints list [--family NAME] [--json] [--format json|ndjson|table]
```

| Flag | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `--family NAME` | Only endpoints in this family. |
| `--json` | Answer with the JSON envelope, whatever stdout is attached to. |
| `--format json\|ndjson\|table` | Choose the output representation. |

```bash
agent-figma api endpoints list --family file --json
```

Answers endpoint metadata list.

### `agent-figma api endpoint describe OPERATION`

Describe one bundled Figma REST operation.

```bash
agent-figma api endpoint describe OPERATION [--json]
```

| Flag | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `--json` | Answer with the JSON envelope, whatever stdout is attached to. |

```bash
agent-figma api endpoint describe file.get --json
```

Answers endpoint metadata.
